;This program copies a block of 5 data bytes starting
; from memory location 30H to another block starting at 40H.

ORG 0000H
MOV R0, #30H      ; R0 points to the source RAM address
MOV R1, #40H      ; R1 points to the destination RAM address
MOV R2, #05H      ; R2 acts as a counter (5 bytes to copy)

BACK: 
MOV A, @R0        ; Copy byte from address in R0 to Accumulator
MOV @R1, A        ; Copy byte from Accumulator to address in R1
INC R0            ; Increment source pointer
INC R1            ; Increment destination pointer
DJNZ R2, BACK     ; Decrement counter R2; if not zero, jump to BACK

END
